pr_title: Add missing is_bitfield field for global enum in extension_api_dump

issue_context.title: GDExtension: Global enum are not marked as bitfield in extension_api.json
comments:
Correcting this is a bit annoying though: the bitfield information is not connected to the type but to the callsite (if `Foo` is a global enum bitfield, it is declared as a regular C++ enum, then used as `Bitfield<Foo>`)
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/60d031777b2a922cba03210181c9ba7ad3a6f3ab/core/input/input.cpp#L746-L748
You should be able to check if the enum is bitfield with `CoreConstants::is_global_constant_bitfield(i)`.

It seems `extension_api_dump` already checks this but if the core constant is an enum (enum name is not empty), it discards it:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/60d031777b2a922cba03210181c9ba7ad3a6f3ab/core/extension/extension_api_dump.cpp#L462-L476
@raulsntos thanks for the tip ! I've submitted PR #71400 then ;-)

review_comments:
I'd rather stick to the current solution, it is in theory less performant (two time more hashmap insert/lookups) but this code is not performance critical so it's no big deal. On the other hand avoiding a new struct declaration make the code a bit simpler (no need to jump between struct declaration and code using it).

But that's not a very strong take, if you really prefere it I will make the change @raulsntos  😃
I'm fine either way so whatever is preferred by the team.
